_comment: The Parkes kettle's build (#927, #711): each stage after the iron frame and its materials, from ParkesKettle/README.md's stage table and the rig's build.stages, in order; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema); README 'Ore machines: what they share'. The brickwork is any one fired brick (oneType: the first sets the setting's brick type; the codes are the rig's bricks.types, red first for the creative shortcut); a click puts in as many of the held stack as the stage still needs. The kettle stage lets the kettle down into its seat with its fire door and damper (the owner's ruling: the doors come with the kettle); the stirrer stage puts up the gallows, the drive and the stirrer. The outlet's cap is not a stage (ParkesKettle/Game/BEParkesKettle.cs). No part wears.
